beats.summary: Michael and Dwight discuss preparing for Dwight's big sales convention speech.

evidence.snippet: Dwight: Well, it's not really a big speech. You still coming right?

beats.summary: Michael attempts to coach Dwight on public speaking skills.

evidence.snippet: Michael: But I can teach you enough so that you don't embarrass me or the company.

beats.summary: Jim and Pam discuss wedding preparations and Jim plans to take a trip to get away.

evidence.snippet: Pam: I have a ton of stuff to do for the wedding. And I have to do it in the office.
Jim: I'm going to take a trip. I'm going to get out of town for a while… and go someplace… not here.

beats.summary: Michael and Dwight exchange jokes about salesmen and saleswomen.

evidence.snippet: Michael (stand up comic voice): But seriously, what's the difference between a salesman and a saleswoman?

beats.summary: Michael announces a $1000 bonus to the office, using it as an example of engaging an audience.

evidence.snippet: Michael: Attention everybody! Attention please! I have some very great news from Corporate. We had a wonderful quarter and as a result all of you are getting bonuses for 1000 dollars!
